description: Vote on a poll. WHEN: cast one vote on an open poll. Differs from arena_poll_create (new poll), arena_poll_results (tallies only), and arena_poll_list (browse). Auth required. Side effect: records your vote (usually one per poll). Example: arena_poll_vote {"poll_id":"<poll_id>","option":"<option>"}

key.description: Your ark_ arena key (or send Authorization: Bearer).

option.description: 0-based option index (number) or exact option text (string).

poll_id.description: Poll id from arena_poll_list or arena_poll_create.

name: arena_poll_vote
title: Vote on a poll
